name: Dan Rocha
office: City of Artesia, Member of the City Council

items.text: Dan Rocha has served Artesia as a Parks and Recreation commissioner and a Beautification and Maintenance commissioner. For development, he supports requiring Project Labor Agreements and prevailing wages on major projects. He has proposed comprehensive traffic studies before new construction and step-down building designs to protect the privacy of single-family homes.

sentences.text: Dan Rocha has served Artesia as a Parks and Recreation commissioner and a Beautification and Maintenance commissioner.
For development, he supports requiring Project Labor Agreements and prevailing wages on major projects.
He has proposed comprehensive traffic studies before new construction and step-down building designs to protect the privacy of single-family homes.

items.text: For public safety, Rocha supports visible patrols from the Los Angeles County Sheriff’s Department and revitalized neighborhood watch programs. He proposes working with LA Metro to reduce construction disruption for small businesses along Pioneer Boulevard and making the future light rail station accessible for seniors and students. He also supports completing upgrades at A.J. Padelford Park and Artesia Park and expanding youth and senior services.
